name: Exp_ClosePositionsByTime
summary: This EA is a utility tool that automatically closes all open positions at a specified time of day. It does not open any trades itself but acts as a time-based position manager to ensure no positions are left open past the user-defined closing time.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个实用工具，在每天指定的时间自动关闭所有持仓。它自身不开放任何交易，而是作为基于时间的仓位管理器，确保在用户定义的收盘时间之后不留任何未平仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于时间的仓位管理，不涉及任何交易信号生成或入场逻辑。入场条件：无，该EA不执行任何入场操作。出场条件：当服务器时间达到用户设定的关闭时间时，遍历所有持仓并逐一平仓。仓位管理：无动态仓位调整，仅在设定时间执行全仓平仓操作。资金管理：无资金管理逻辑，不涉及风险控制或仓位计算。该EA本质上是一个定时执行的仓位清算工具，适用于需要在特定时间（如收盘前或重要新闻发布前）清空所有持仓的交易者。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is time-based position management with no trade signal generation or entry logic involved. Entry conditions: None; this EA does not execute any entry operations. Exit conditions: When server time reaches the user-defined closing time, it iterates through all open positions and closes them one by one. Position sizing: No dynamic position adjustment; it only executes a full close-all operation at the configured time. Money management: No money management logic is present; it does not involve risk control or lot size calculation. The EA is essentially a scheduled position liquidation tool suitable for traders who need to clear all positions at a specific time, such as before market close or before major news releases.

parameters.name: CloseTime
parameters.description: 每日自动平仓的时间点

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定平仓的魔术号码，0表示所有头寸
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

pros: 操作简单直观，只需设置一个平仓时间即可自动执行
有效避免隔夜风险或特定时段的持仓风险
可配合其他交易策略使用，作为风控辅助工具
pros_en: Simple and intuitive operation — just set a closing time and it executes automatically
Effectively avoids overnight risk or position risk during specific time periods
Can be used alongside other trading strategies as a risk management辅助 tool
cons: 功能单一，仅支持定时平仓，缺乏更灵活的条件判断
未考虑市场流动性和滑点问题，可能在低流动性时段造成不利成交
没有日志记录或通知功能，用户无法确认平仓执行情况
cons_en: Single-function utility that only supports scheduled closing, lacking more flexible conditional logic
Does not account for market liquidity and slippage, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
No logging or notification functionality, making it impossible for users to confirm execution status
improvements: 增加部分平仓功能和平仓前预警通知机制
加入流动性检测和滑点保护，避免在低流动性时段执行平仓
improvements_en: Add partial close functionality and a pre-close alert/notification mechanism
Include liquidity detection and slippage protection to avoid closing positions during low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 定时平仓可能在极端行情下因滑点导致实际成交价偏离预期
若平仓时间设置不当，可能在市场休市时段无法执行
risk_points_en: Scheduled closing may result in actual fill prices deviating from expected due to slippage during extreme market conditions
If the closing time is set incorrectly, execution may fail during market-off hours

summary_en: This EA is a utility tool that automatically closes all open positions at a specified time of day. It does not open any trades itself but acts as a time-based position manager to ensure no positions are left open past the user-defined closing time.
